description: REGRESSION SNAPSHOT, not a closed form. Cauchy stress for a fully constrained single element (F = I) under isotropic growth Fg = (1+alpha)I, obtained by CALLING stress_core -- so these values record what the implementation does and cannot test whether it is right. They are useful only for detecting drift. For an independent check see apdl/closed_form_reference.py and tests/test_closed_form_reference.py, which derive the same cases from the continuum model; the constrained case differs from these values by the spherical term described in DEVIATOR_SCALING_FINDING.md. ANSYS Voigt order 11,22,33,12,23,13. Generated by make_reference.py; do not hand-edit.
